answer: A fresh account starts as a blank atlas with near-zero weight; standing only accrues as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs. Each identity must lock a refundable bond, so a clone fleet funds a separate stake and waits its own vesting window per fake, and sybil cost scales linearly. A falcon-eyed verifier watches for correlated funding and timing, and no clever trick lets a swarm bridge straight into the trusted set.
